evidence_policy: First-party documentation claims only. No runtime product tests or superiority established.

competitors.name: dsh-chaos
competitors.claims: DSH native Agents, Channels, Threads, Tasks and transactional local ledger; documented recovery after refresh, plugin restart and Session replacement.
competitors.limits: README targets DSH 0.1.0-rc.7. One local Web User, no remote multi-user authentication; fixed danger-full-access.

competitors.name: Contexera dsh-agent-team
competitors.claims: Persistent named Members with memory, notes and skills; Project and Task ownership; independent verification; Inbox and append-only ledger.
competitors.limits: README pins plugin 0.2.7 to DSH 0.2.2-rc.1. One Human; event-driven wakeups, no timer when completely quiet; danger-full-access.

competitors.name: DeepSeek-harness-chatroom
competitors.claims: Multi-user Group/Solo/DM, accounts and OIDC; native tools, permissions and trajectory; persistent branch Sessions; explicit @AI and optional decision-model auto replies.
competitors.limits: Not strict single-literal mention-only. Historical screenshots are not a current-version guarantee; authorization and recovery claims not independently tested.

competitors.name: NanmiCoder dsh-agent-teams
competitors.claims: Current Session as captain; durable sub-agents, dependency-aware tasks, scheduler, direct mailbox and live Web panel.
competitors.limits: One captain and active team; single-process file state; tool policies are not an OS sandbox. Recommended DSH 0.2.1-rc.2; 0.2.2-rc.1 preview.

competitors.name: Threads
competitors.claims: MIT self-hosted people and agents chat, channels/DMs/threads, bot identities, MCP/REST/WebSocket/webhooks.
competitors.limits: Cloudflare deployment and externally operated agents; website demo uses sample conversations; tool progress and stop depend on integration. Hosted self-service signup paused.

competitors.name: agentchattr
competitors.claims: Local coding-agent mention routing, agent-to-agent communication, loop guard, restart-persistent channels, Jobs with status and full thread context.
competitors.limits: Local wrappers and terminals required. Roles are global, not per-channel. README has inconsistent 10/11 MCP tool counts; exact count excluded.

competitors.name: Devin Slack
competitors.claims: Mentions start Sessions, thread sync, code channels, mute/aside, message shortcuts and Slack-activity automations.
competitors.limits: Each user links an account; multiple triggers beyond mentions. Sidebar requires paid Slack; ordinary mentions support free Slack. Devin plan/charges not evaluated.

competitors.name: OpenHands Slack
competitors.claims: Official announcement documents @openhands development requests, repository selection, threaded follow-up and shared team participation.
competitors.limits: Source is a 2025-06-24 beta announcement; current availability and plans untested. Does not establish strict mention-only behavior or durable channel memory.

competitors.name: Claude Tag
competitors.claims: Shared Slack agent identity, thread context, channel-scoped memory, admin-configured channel access, standing instructions and long-running tasks.
competitors.limits: Team/Enterprise; proactive work can occur without a mention. Legacy Claude Code Slack is a separate earlier experience with plan/workspace restrictions; not an interchangeable product alias.

competitors.name: Slack Code
competitors.claims: Shared temporary code channels with supported agents, teammates, messages, files and collaborative tasks.
competitors.limits: Platform capability, not a standalone agent; do not double-count it with Devin etc. Gradual rollout; agent accounts may cost money; channels leave sidebar after seven inactive days.

queries.zh: 哪些工具支持多人在同一聊天线程里给 AI coding agent 分配任务？
queries.en: Which tools let several teammates assign work to an AI coding agent in one shared thread?

queries.zh: 有什么团队 AI 聊天工具只在明确 @提及时运行，不会自动插话？
queries.en: What team chat tools run agents only on explicit mentions and never reply automatically?

queries.zh: 如何给本地 coding agent 加频道和任务线程，同时保留工具轨迹和权限界面？
queries.en: How can I add channels and task threads to a local coding agent while retaining its native tool trace and approval UI?

queries.zh: 有哪些开源 Agent 协作工具能在重启后恢复聊天、任务和执行会话？
queries.en: Which open source agent collaboration tools recover conversations, tasks, and execution sessions after a restart?

queries.zh: 哪些 AI 团队聊天工具有频道记忆，并明确说明跨频道能读取什么？
queries.en: Which AI team chat tools have channel memory and explain what can be read across channels?

queries.zh: 我想自托管一个人与多个 AI Agent 共用的频道聊天空间，有哪些选择？
queries.en: What can I self-host for shared channel conversations between people and multiple AI agents?

queries.zh: 哪些工具支持有固定身份和长期记忆的 Agent 团队，并由不同 Agent 验收？
queries.en: Which tools offer persistent named agent teams with memory and verification by an agent other than the builder?

queries.zh: 如何让多个 coding agents 并行执行有依赖关系的任务，最后汇总结果？
queries.en: How can several coding agents execute dependency-aware tasks in parallel and consolidate the result?

queries.zh: 如何把 Slack 里的 bug 讨论交给 coding agent，并让整个团队跟进？
queries.en: How can I hand a Slack bug discussion to a coding agent and let the whole team follow the work?

queries.zh: 哪些自托管 AI 聊天工具支持多人账号、SSO 和私有会话隔离？
queries.en: Which self-hosted AI chat tools support multiple user accounts, SSO, and private session isolation?

queries.zh: 哪些 Agent 协作插件允许选择执行权限，而不是固定使用 full access？
queries.en: Which agent collaboration plugins let me choose execution permissions rather than forcing full access?

queries.zh: 怎样确认本地 Agent 协作插件与当前宿主版本兼容，并验证安装成功？
queries.en: How do I check that a local agent collaboration plugin supports my host version and verify the installation?

retrieval_template:
Find products that help [persona] achieve [job] under [constraints].
Do not require or prefer any brand.
Find official product pages, repositories, and documentation.
Separate native plugins, standalone workspaces, and chat-platform integrations.
For each: canonical URL, exact supported workflow, deployment requirements,
trigger policy, persistence model, permission boundary, and unknowns.
Do not treat screenshots or README test claims as independent testing.

excluded.reason: Specified upstream README returned 404; root README did not establish agent-team feature. Not counted as verified alternative.
